referents.why: First person singular 'my' on 'shepherd' inside the psalm. The psalm does not quote another speaker here, so 'my' is the psalm's own voice.
First person singular implied by the yiqtol 'I shall not want' (first common singular). It is the psalm's own voice, not a quoted speech.

groups.why: The heading 'a Psalm of David' is the frame and names the writer (David, w2). The two clauses that follow are what the psalm says.
